draft.title: Setting and subplot
card: the time and place of a story. It can be a season, a decade, a town or a single room.
Setting shapes mood, the feeling a reader gets. A dark, empty street at midnight feels tense. A sunny beach in summer feels relaxed.
a smaller story line that runs beside the main plot. It has its own events, but it is not the main story.
A subplot often adds to the ideas of the main plot. For example, a main plot about winning a race might have a subplot about a friendship that is tested.
draft.remember: Setting is when and where, and it shapes mood. A subplot runs beside the main plot and adds to its ideas.

a.q: A story opens in a cold, dim school hall, empty after a storm has knocked out the power. What is the setting doing here?
opts: Creating a lonely, uneasy mood
Starting a subplot about the school
Telling the reader the hero's traits
Showing the climax of the story
a.why: The time and place, an empty, dim hall after a storm, shape the mood and make it feel lonely and uneasy. It is not a subplot, because a subplot is a separate story line, not a place.
a.clue: Think about how the time and place would make a reader feel.

b.q: In a novel, Priya spends the whole story trying to save her family's farm in a drought. Beside this, her brother Sam slowly mends his friendship with a neighbour. What is Sam's story?
opts: A subplot that runs beside the main plot
The setting, because it happens on the farm
The main plot, because Sam is in the family
The mood, because it is about feelings
b.why: Sam's friendship has its own events and runs beside Priya's main story about the farm, so it is a subplot. It happens on the farm, but a setting is a time and place, not a story line.
b.clue: Which part is a smaller story line beside the main one?

b.best: A subplot that runs beside the main plot

problems.detail: The card says a subplot 'often' adds to the ideas of the main plot, but the remember line drops 'often' and states it as always true, which overstates the card.

b.q: In a novel, Priya spends the whole story trying to save her family's farm in a drought. At the same time, her brother Sam slowly mends his friendship with a neighbour. What is Sam's story?

The main plot, because Sam is part of Priya's family
The mood, because it is about how the characters feel
